title: Pure Binaurals (80 : 100)
description: This hour long recording is formed from carefully selected binaural beats. There are no subliminal words or hidden traps, just pure sound frequencies for you to enjoy. With today's teaser announcement that playlists are just around the corner, now is the perfect time to add in some extra possibilities for you to get creative with :). This track will nicely layer on top of many other files, and so I encourage you to mix and match to find out what works for you.
author: Mistress Shibby
